integrity: The first verified related online source is François–Mioland (2007-02-04); the primary probability subject code 60K35 is listed in Janson–Kersting arxiv:1004.5011. A finite-sample analytical result for the neutral, constant-size binary Kingman coalescent. The proof fixes the per-pair coalescence rate at one; exact-rational enumeration and recursions are supporting checks rather than infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: No assertion of independence or an explicit joint distribution.
Not extended to variable population size or multiple-merger coalescents.
Possible older mixed generating-function results under alternative names remain an originality risk.
title: Sample-size-invariant cherry–external-length covariance in Kingman’s coalescent
